messages:
jess_csm: Quick sync — Aurelia Health asked for a monthly SLA breakdown before renewal. Can we confirm how we compute 'platform uptime' vs 'model availability'? Need it by EOD Thursday.

omar_eng: I can clarify. Platform uptime = control plane + routing + serving node health (our probe). Model availability = model variant online in region.

sara_onboard: FYI during onboarding they saw higher tail latency on long-context invoices, might affect latency SLO.

mike_sales: Renewal flagged in 2 weeks. If we can't show adherence they may ask for credits. Need exact numbers.

omar_eng: Proposed SLO buckets:
```
{
  "uptime_slo": "99.9",
  "latency_p50_ms": "120",
  "latency_p95_ms": "450"
}
```
This matches what we report to enterprise.

jess_csm: How do we convert missed SLO into credit? Customer contract uses monthly uptime % thresholds.

sara_onboard: Example calculation we used for Beacon (internal):
- >=99.9% no credit
- 99.0-99.9% -> 5% credit
- <99.0% -> 10% credit

omar_eng: I'll pull the exact last 3 months metrics and attach CSV in thread. @reporting-bot can you generate the monthly uptime and p95 report for Aurelia Health for Jan-Mar?

reporting-bot: Generated report: https://redwood.internal/reports/aur-sla-janmar.csv :white_check_mark:

jess_csm: Awesome. Can you also add a latency breakdown by model variant? CEO asks specifically about 'redwood-ld-3b-q' region-us-west.

omar_eng: Will add. Also, recommend we offer a one-off operational review with the customer — show runbook, fallback policies, and suggested prom/p95 dashboards.

mike_sales: I'll propose the review as part of renewal conversation. If we show improvement plan, risk reduces.

jess_csm: Action items:
1) @omar_eng pull metrics + latency by variant (due: tomorrow noon)
2) @reporting-bot attach CSV and compute credits if any (due: tomorrow EOD)
3) @sara_onboard prep onboarding notes re: long-context latency (due: Friday)
4) @mike_sales schedule renewal review (due: next Tue)

Thanks team :thumbsup:
